user.title: Choose manufacturer
user.description: Connect supported heating, ventilation and building controllers locally.

model.title: Choose controller model
model.description: Select the exact model and firmware. EH-800B USB exposes its reviewed L1 controls automatically; other controllers require explicit write permission.

data.allow_writes: Allow reviewed writes for other models (EH-800B USB controls are separate)

advisor.title: Local English AI advisor
advisor.description: Optional private-LAN Ollama model. An English rule-based guide works without Ollama. AI never changes controller settings.

data.ai_auto_review: Review measurements at startup and about every six hours
data.allow_writes: Enable reviewed setpoint writes (off by default; unknown points remain read-only)

register_map.title: Register map
register_map.description: Add a confirmed JSON map and turn off Discovery Mode to create measurement entities. Map addresses are one-based. Saving does not write to the controller.

research.title: Modbus research — read only
research.description: Try 1–8 comma-separated Unit IDs. Identification 43/14 needs no register address. FC03/04 requires an address from an identified source and its address base. Results never automatically become entities.

data.documented: The address comes from an identified document
